messages:
maria: Heads up — embeddings-serving spiking with 5xxs since 01:12 UTC. Root looks like the migration sidecar not completing and causing worker panics. Need a hotfix that restarts the worker and toggles the migration flag. Requesting expedited deploy with a manual gate: SRE + Product. Preferred change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. deploybot, can you intake and queue?

deploybot: Hotfix request received for service=embeddings. Requirements: 2 approvers (sre, product), runbook snippet, rollback criteria. Proposed image: redwood/embeds:2026.03-hotfix-mig. Proposed canary: 10% for 5m. To schedule: `deploybot schedule --service embeddings --image redwood/embeds:2026.03-hotfix-mig --window 02:00-03:00 --manual-gate`

ken: I'm oncall. I can review/approve but need rollback plan and quick smoke steps.

maria: Runbook (short): 1) Kick canary (10% for 5m). 2) Observe errors /metrics?service=embeddings&window=5m. 3) If errors >1% or latency p95 increases >200ms -> rollback. Rollback command (one-liner):
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/embeddings embeddings=redwood/embeds:2026.03-stable && kubectl rollout restart deploy/embeddings
```
4) Notify customers and post release note.

aj: Product here — need a 1-2 sentence release note and confirmation this won't change schema. Also want a temporary flag in the image so we can flip back without code change.

maria: release note draft: "Hotfix: embeddings worker restart to address intermittent migration deadlock causing 5xxs. No schema changes. Customers may see transient latency during rollout." Flag present: MIGRATION_FLIP=false -> true at deploy.

aj: ok from Product, +1 :thumbsup:

ken: smoke checklist for staging I ran: healthcheck ok, kv cache warm, sample inference latencies stable. staging smoke passed at 01:40 UTC. I can approve once canary is green.

elaine: ran the staging smoke run as well, confirmed. Logs show migration sidecar finishes within 12s now with the hotfix image.

deploybot: Manual gate created. To approve root thread run: `/deploy approve 6150000001 --by @ken` and `/deploy approve 6150000001 --by @aj`. Both approvals required. Canary flow: 10% -> 5m -> promote to 100% if no alerts.

sam: I'll watch metrics from ops during the window and be ready to execute rollback. Add me to the phone bridge when you kick.

maria: scheduling for 02:00 UTC. Plan: kick canary 02:01, observe 5m, then promote at ~02:07 if green. I'll post the release notes to #release-notes after full rollout.

deploybot: Canary started at 02:01 UTC (10% traffic). Canary id: cb-6150000001-canary. Initial canary metrics: errors=0.1%, p95 latency +30ms.

elaine: canary logs look good. No repeated panics.

ken: affirmative from SRE — canary green. Approving full rollout. `/deploy approve 6150000001 --by @ken` executed.

aj: approving from Product now. `/deploy approve 6150000001 --by @aj` executed.

deploybot: Both approvals received. Promoting canary to 100% at 02:07 UTC. Rolling update in progress.

deploybot: Rollout complete at 02:09 UTC. Observability: errors stayed ~0.09%, p95 within expected bounds. No rollback executed.

releasebot: Release note posted: https://docs.internal/release-notes/2026-03-embeds-hotfix (draft).

sam: Monitoring during window — everything looks stable. I'll keep the bridge open for +30m.

maria: Thanks all. Closing thread after monitoring period. Will open a follow-up if anything needs rollback or backfill. :white_check_mark:
